news.Title: How Does Meta's Muse AI Raise Risks for Banks & Other Finance Firms?
news.Content:
Meta's fast-rising Muse AI agent has emerged as a fresh concern for finance stocks, as investors assess whether autonomous AI assistants could weaken the customer stickiness that supports banks, brokerages and wealth managers.

The development weighed on several major financial names yesterday. Charles Schwab SCHW was among the hardest hit, declining 6.1%, while JPMorgan JPM and Wells Fargo WFC dropped more than 3% each. Morgan Stanley MS also declined more than 2.5% as markets considered how AI-powered financial decision-making could reshape competition across the industry.

Banks Could Face Higher Deposit Competition

For banks, including JPMorgan and Wells Fargo, the key risk centers on deposits. AI agents could eventually monitor savings rates across institutions, identify higher-yielding alternatives and move funds with minimal customer involvement.

Such capabilities could reduce deposit inertia, making customers more responsive to rate differences. That might force banks to offer more competitive deposit pricing, potentially increasing funding costs and creating pressure on net interest margin (NIM).

SCHW & Morgan Stanley Face Greater Fee Transparency

For Schwab and Morgan Stanley, the challenge is more closely tied to brokerage and wealth management. AI agents could make it easier for clients to compare advisory fees, brokerage costs, cash yields and investment products across competing platforms.

Over time, customers could use autonomous assistants to locate lower-cost products, optimize idle cash or initiate account transfers. That may increase fee transparency, lower switching barriers and raise customer-retention costs.

What This Means for the Finance Industry

The main concern is not that AI agents will replace banks, brokers or wealth managers. Instead, they could make it much easier for customers to switch between financial providers.

For JPM, WFC, SCHW, MS and other financial firms, this could mean tougher competition for deposits, investment assets and advisory clients. Customers may be able to use AI tools to quickly compare interest rates, fees, investment products and services, and then move their money to a better option with less effort.

The impact on earnings is still uncertain. However, Meta's Muse has brought more attention to the risk that AI could reduce customer loyalty and make financial relationships less sticky over time.

news.Title: 〈美股早盤〉油價與美債殖利率攀升 主要指數開低
news.Content:
美股主要指數周三(23日)開盤走低，油價止住今年來最長連跌走勢，加上美國公債殖利率攀升，壓抑股市表現。美伊戰爭前景再添變數，投資人正密切關注結束中東衝突的談判進展，同時等待備受矚目的川習會登場。

截稿前， 道瓊工業指數 跌近170點或近 0.3%， 那斯達克綜合指數 跌逾130點或近 0.5%， 標普 500 指數 跌近0.3%， 費城半導體 指數跌近1.8%，台積電ADR跌近1.0%。

美股與美債周三同步走低，布蘭特原油價格重返每桶100美元上方，終止連續五天跌勢。市場一面等待美伊談判取得更多進展，一面擔心油價反彈再度推升通膨，迫使聯準會(Fed)升息。美元則攀至7月以來最高。

先前一波漲勢已讓標普500指數逼近歷史高點，但隨著油價止跌，股市漲勢暫時歇腳。美債也承壓，其中短天期公債表現較弱，反映投資人重新評估能源成本上升對Fed利率決策的影響。

中東局勢仍是市場焦點。美國總統川普透露，美國與伊朗的談判取得進展，讓投資人期待戰事有望結束，並視外交突破為帶動風險資產上漲的可能契機。這也是兩國自6月中旬左右、短暫停火協議簽署後首次展開磋商。不過，談判能否促成具體成果，目前仍不明朗。

伊朗總統裴澤斯基安預定周三在聯合國大會發表演說。伊朗IRIB News報導，伊朗已就重新開放荷姆茲海峽提出「堅定立場」。這條航道能否恢復通行，是市場判斷能源供應壓力會否緩解的關鍵之一。

BMO Capital Markets的Ian Lyngen指出，最新談判雖讓市場看見結束美伊戰爭的希望，但雙方是否已朝正式達成荷姆茲海峽重新開放協議取得進展，仍不得而知。他表示，若外交突破的期待落空，能源價格反彈可能引發新一波美債賣壓；反之，若油價延續跌勢，將有助於支撐美債。

news.Title: Alibaba's Quick Commerce Growth Accelerates: Can It Boost Revenues?
news.Content:
Alibaba BABA is accelerating its Quick Commerce business, creating a growing revenue stream that could strengthen the company's broader e-commerce network. In the June 2026 quarter, China Quick Commerce revenues rose 45% year over year to RMB53.3 billion, driven by Freshippo and Taobao Instant Commerce. Taobao Instant Commerce also improved its unit economics while maintaining market share, supported by higher average order values and better fulfillment efficiency.

The opportunity extends beyond direct Quick Commerce revenues. Alibaba is expanding into higher-value food and non-food categories, while stronger engagement on Taobao can increase monthly active consumers and support customer-management revenues. Freshippo's continued order and revenue growth, along with deeper integration with Taobao Instant Commerce, further broadens the platform's supply and product offering.

Quick Commerce could become Alibaba's Second Growth Curve. Alibaba expects Quick Commerce to eventually contribute around 30% of platform GMV, highlighting its potential to become a major growth engine for the e-commerce business.

The key challenge is profitability. Management expects Quick Commerce to reach overall profitability only in fiscal 2029, meaning rapid revenue growth still requires significant investment before translating into sustained profits.

The Zacks Consensus Estimate for fiscal 2027 revenues is pegged at $166.75 billion, implying 14.66% year-over-year growth. This suggests that Alibaba's expanding Quick Commerce business could contribute meaningfully to future revenue growth, although converting that scale into sustainable profitability remains crucial.

Amazon and DoorDash Intensify Quick-Commerce Rivalry

Amazon AMZN is expanding its ultrafast-commerce footprint through Amazon Now, offering thousands of everyday essentials within 30 minutes or less. In the second quarter of 2026, Amazon added 80 U.S. cities and towns, reaching more than 250 locations globally, while gross sales and units sold grew over 80% quarter over quarter. This broad selection and faster fulfillment put Amazon directly against Alibaba's expanding quick-commerce plan.

DoorDash DASH is broadening beyond restaurant delivery into grocery and retail, strengthening its local-commerce challenge. DoorDash says grocery is its fastest-growing marketplace category, while DashMart Fulfillment Services enables controlled inventory and rapid delivery. It also reported near-24/7 warehouse operations and 10-times better error rates, giving DoorDash another route to compete with Alibaba's quick-commerce model.

news.Title: Wall Street Bulls Look Optimistic About TSMC (TSM): Should You Buy?
news.Content:
When deciding whether to buy, sell, or hold a stock, investors often rely on analyst recommendations. Media reports about rating changes by these brokerage-firm-employed (or sell-side) analysts often influence a stock's price, but are they really important?

Before we discuss the reliability of brokerage recommendations and how to use them to your advantage, let's see what these Wall Street heavyweights think about TSMC (TSM).

TSMC currently has an average brokerage recommendation (ABR) of 1.22, on a scale of 1 to 5 (Strong Buy to Strong Sell), calculated based on the actual recommendations (Buy, Hold, Sell, etc.) made by 18 brokerage firms. An ABR of 1.22 approximates between Strong Buy and Buy.

Of the 18 recommendations that derive the current ABR, 15 are Strong Buy and two are Buy. Strong Buy and Buy respectively account for 83.3% and 11.1% of all recommendations.

Brokerage Recommendation Trends for TSM

Check price target & stock forecast for TSMC here>>>

While the ABR calls for buying TSMC, it may not be wise to make an investment decision solely based on this information. Several studies have shown limited to no success of brokerage recommendations in guiding investors to pick stocks with the best price increase potential.

Are you wondering why? The vested interest of brokerage firms in a stock they cover often results in a strong positive bias of their analysts in rating it. Our research shows that for every "Strong Sell" recommendation, brokerage firms assign five "Strong Buy" recommendations.

This means that the interests of these institutions are not always aligned with those of retail investors, giving little insight into the direction of a stock's future price movement. It would therefore be best to use this information to validate your own analysis or a tool that has proven to be highly effective at predicting stock price movements.

With an impressive externally audited track record, our proprietary stock rating tool, the Zacks Rank, which classifies stocks into five groups, ranging from Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) to Zacks Rank #5 (Strong Sell), is a reliable indicator of a stock's near-term price performance. So, validating the Zacks Rank with ABR could go a long way in making a profitable investment decision.

ABR Should Not Be Confused With Zacks Rank

In spite of the fact that Zacks Rank and ABR both appear on a scale from 1 to 5, they are two completely different measures.

Broker recommendations are the sole basis for calculating the ABR, which is typically displayed in decimals (such as 1.28). The Zacks Rank, on the other hand, is a quantitative model designed to harness the power of earnings estimate revisions. It is displayed in whole numbers -- 1 to 5.

Story Continues

It has been and continues to be the case that analysts employed by brokerage firms are overly optimistic with their recommendations. Because of their employers' vested interests, these analysts issue more favorable ratings than their research would support, misguiding investors far more often than helping them.

On the other hand, earnings estimate revisions are at the core of the Zacks Rank. And empirical research shows a strong correlation between trends in earnings estimate revisions and near-term stock price movements.

Furthermore, the different grades of the Zacks Rank are applied proportionately across all stocks for which brokerage analysts provide earnings estimates for the current year. In other words, at all times, this tool maintains a balance among the five ranks it assigns.

Another key difference between the ABR and Zacks Rank is freshness. The ABR is not necessarily up-to-date when you look at it. But, since brokerage analysts keep revising their earnings estimates to account for a company's changing business trends, and their actions get reflected in the Zacks Rank quickly enough, it is always timely in indicating future price movements.

Should You Invest in TSM?

In terms of earnings estimate revisions for TSMC, the Zacks Consensus Estimate for the current year has increased 0.7% over the past month to $16.56.

Analysts' growing optimism over the company's earnings prospects, as indicated by strong agreement among them in revising EPS estimates higher, could be a legitimate reason for the stock to soar in the near term.

The size of the recent change in the consensus estimate, along with three other factors related to earnings estimates, has resulted in a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) for TSMC. You can see the complete list of today's Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) stocks here >>>>

news.Title: QCOM Launches Next-Gen Snapdragon SoCs: Will Agentic AI Drive Growth?
news.Content:
Qualcomm Incorporated QCOM is strengthening its position in the premium smartphone market with the launch of two new flagship mobile platforms called Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 and Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6. Built on advanced 2nm technology, the new Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chip is Qualcomm's most powerful mobile platform, and both the chips are designed to support AI-driven experiences. The new SoCs are engineered to bring faster on-device AI, gaming, imaging and connectivity capabilities to next-generation smartphones.

The push toward agentic AI is important here. Smartphone AI is gradually moving beyond conventional cloud-based features toward greater on-device processing. Higher con device computing capability can enable smartphones to handle more AI workloads directly on the device. The Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 introduces Adreno Neural Fusion, which uses AI to enhance graphics and gaming experiences. The platform also adds AI-powered camera capabilities, including Advanced Professional Video (APV) support. Per Qualcomm, the Intelligent Pixel Control feature can improve scene understanding and image quality.

Qualcomm's strategy of introducing two premium flagship chips instead of one gives OEMs better options for their unique requirements. Owing to its leading-edge features, the chips have already generated early interest from major companies. Leading smartphone brands, such as HONOR, Motorola, OnePlus, OPPO, vivo and Xiaomi, are expected to launch devices powered by the new Snapdragon platforms.

QCT handset revenues fell 20% year over year to $5.09 billion in the fiscal third quarter as major OEMs reduced purchases. It is to be noted that memory pricing, supply constraints and cyclicality in the handset market continue to weigh on QCOM's smartphone business. The new chips are primarily targeted at premium and top-tier smartphones, so their impact on Qualcomm's financial results will depend on continuous demand and adoption.

How Are Competitors Faring?

Qualcomm faces competition from STMicroelectronics N.V. STM and Intel Corporation INTC in the semiconductor space. STM has a strong presence in the smartphone semiconductor ecosystem. Its portfolio consists of sensing, connectivity, security and power-management technologies. STM provides components that support functions ranging from imaging and environmental sensing to wireless connectivity and secure mobile services. Recently, the company introduced the ST54M, a single-die secure mobile chip that is designed to support secure mobile services such as digital payments, identity credentials and access control.

Intel competes with Qualcomm in the broader semiconductor space. Intel is building a broader AI infrastructure platform spanning CPUs, ASICs, graphics, networking and advanced packaging as customers design workload-specific systems. Its AI PC and edge strategy is gaining traction as AI workloads move closer to devices and enterprise customers seek efficient local processing.

Story Continues

QCOM's Price Performance, Valuation and Estimates

Qualcomm shares have gained 17% over the past year compared with the industry's growth of 39.5%.

Image Source: Zacks Investment Research

Going by the price/earnings ratio, the company's shares currently trade at 19.76 forward earnings, higher than 13.96 for the industry.

Earnings estimates for fiscal 2026 and 2027 have decreased over the past 60 days.

news.Title: AI落地遇記憶體供需失衡　群聯潘健成：好像只有宏碁不苦
news.Content:
（中央社記者吳家豪台北2026年09月23日電）人工智慧（AI）浪潮走向終端邊緣運算，但記憶體供需失衡成為AI落地的最大絆腳石。快閃記憶體控制晶片廠群聯電子 (8299) 創辦人暨執行長潘健成今天表示，AI落地最大挑戰是動態隨機存取記憶體（DRAM），業界大概都為DRAM所苦，然而「從媒體看到好像只有宏碁不苦」。

宏碁 (2353) 董事長暨執行長陳俊聖日前受訪談到零組件市況時表示，目前記憶體並非全面短缺，其中DDR4、DDR5等主流電腦記憶體供應增多不會缺貨，DDRX、DDR5X等記憶體產品相對仍缺貨，但需求量較小，相關言論在科技圈掀起熱烈討論。

潘健成今天在工業電腦廠東擎科技 (7710) 上市前業績發表會致詞時表示，過去4年AI都在談算力和伺服器，未來包括AI導入裝置端、物聯網與邊緣端，勢必將百花齊放。

談到當前業界痛點，潘健成說，AI要落地使用，DRAM是有錢不一定買得到，買得到不一定賣得掉；「我想台下大概今天都為DRAM所苦，對不對？從媒體看到好像只有宏碁不苦」。

為解決高昂成本，潘健成提到，群聯透過aiDAPTIV+軟體架構搭配自研固態硬碟（SSD）方案，能以有限的DRAM讓AI模型順暢運作，並與超微（AMD）、英特爾（Intel）、輝達（NVIDIA）生態系及高通等處理器平台完成概念驗證（POC），大幅降低邊緣AI落地門檻。

潘健成也在現場大方「固料」。他透露，過去11個月快閃記憶體（Flash）嚴重缺貨，但東擎科技是群聯的重要合作夥伴，「從現在開始，你要的Flash方案，群聯電子保證滿足，要多少給多少」，贏得現場熱烈掌聲。

news.Title: IREN Has Microsoft and $14 Billion of Funding. Execution Is the Real Test
news.Content: IREN's AI pivot has reached the point where the balance sheet looks almost as dramatic as the growth plan. The Bitcoin miner-turned-AI cloud operator ended June with about $7.6 billion of cash, including $1.7 billion that was restricted, while management says says existing cash, committed GPU financing and customer prepayments provide roughly $14 billion of funding capacity. The first major proof point is already live: Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ: MSFT ) accepted the first Horizon deployment in August under a broader multiyear arrangement, while IREN Limited (NASDAQ: IREN ) is redirecting sites, capital and staff toward AI cloud infrastructure. The question is whether that cash pile represents protection or simply the opening balance for an even larger spending cycle. Microsoft de-risks demand, not construction IREN Limited (NASDAQ:IREN) says its 2026 capacity is largely sold and that recent customer prepayments can fund roughly half of GPU capital expenditure on new contracts. Management is targeting cumulative delivery of about 300 megawatts of IT load in 2026 and 800 megawatts in 2027, with fiscal 2027 capital spending estimated at $25 billion to $30 billion. The Microsoft relationship supports the bull case because a large customer can improve financing terms and utilization visibility. It does not eliminate schedule risk, equipment lead times or the possibility that project costs rise faster than contracted economics. Photo from IREN website Hedge funds moved aggressively into IREN before the latest delivery milestone. Insider Monkey's database showed 69 holders in Q2 2026, up from 53 in Q1. Value Aligned Research Advisors increased its position 78% to about 8.47 million shares. Short interest was 93.61 million shares as of August 31, around 25.01% of float with 2.06 days to cover. IREN also has convertible debt and other financing structures, so the raw short percentage can overstate purely directional bearishness. Microsoft is buying capacity while preserving options Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ:MSFT) gets access to liquid-cooled GPU capacity without owning every physical asset IREN builds. That helps while Azure demand remains capacity-constrained. The bear case is long-term commitment risk. Hyperscalers are signing infrastructure contracts during a period of scarce power and GPUs, and better hardware efficiency or slower AI demand could change the economics before every contract rolls off. Microsoft's hedge-fund count fell to 273 in Q2 from 282 in Q1, although Arrowstreet Capital increased its stake about 14%. Those filings predate IREN's August handover and cannot show a reaction to it. Story Continues IREN now has the ingredients investors wanted from the mining-to-AI pivot: power, cash, GPUs and a hyperscaler customer. The remaining risk is brutally ordinary. It has to turn tens of billions of dollars of capital into commissioned capacity fast enough to earn returns before technology and rental pricing move again. Microsoft reduces demand uncertainty. It cannot build the data centers for IREN. news.Title: Micron vs. Sandisk: Which AI Memory Stock Has More Room to Run?
news.Content:
Micron Technology (NASDAQ: MU) and Sandisk (NASDAQ: SNDK) have been multibagger investments over the past year, making investors significantly richer owing to the incredible demand for memory in artificial intelligence (AI) data centers.

While Micron stock has surged by an incredible 541% over the past year, Sandisk has clocked phenomenal gains of 1,600%. The good news for investors is that Wall Street expects both stocks to jump higher. Let's take a closer look at their prospects and check which one of these two stocks is likely to deliver bigger gains.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Micron enjoys an edge over Sandisk

Micron's 12-month median price target of $1,600 points to a 53% jump from current levels, according to 57 analysts covering the stock. Sandisk stock, on the other hand, is projected to jump by 24% over the coming year, based on its median price target of $2,200 as per 32 analysts covering it.

It is easy to see why analysts are forecasting a bigger jump in Micron stock. The company sells both dynamic random-access memory (DRAM) and NAND flash memory, while Sandisk is a pure-play NAND flash manufacturer. What's more, Micron enjoys a bigger market share of 15% in NAND flash compared to Sandisk's share of 11%, according to Counterpoint Research.

Additionally, Micron has been gaining share in the fast-growing DRAM market. Its share of this space increased to 24% in Q2 this year, up from 22% in Q1. So, Micron is in a stronger position to capitalize on the secular growth of the memory market.

Deloitte estimates that DRAM prices will increase by 4x in 2026. Moreover, the strong pricing environment in this market is here to stay as new supply isn't expected to arrive until 2029 or 2030, according to the consulting giant. Sandisk's pure-play NAND flash business model indicates that it is going to miss out on the DRAM market's robust growth.

This probably explains why Micron is anticipated to clock significantly stronger earnings per share (EPS) growth over the long run.

Another reason why Micron is a better buy right now

We have already seen that Micron's presence in both the DRAM and NAND flash markets is going to drive stronger growth for the company compared to Sandisk. Additionally, both stocks are almost identically valued, with Micron being slightly cheaper.

Story Continues

So, investors looking to choose one of these AI stocks for their portfolio have an easy choice to make. Analysts expect Micron to deliver bigger gains over the coming year, and it is easy to see why that's likely to be the case. Moreover, Micron has the potential to surge significantly by 2030 , making it an ideal bet for investors looking to buy a top AI stock trading at a discount right now.

news.Title: Morgan Stanley Just Put a $54 Target on This AI-Pivoting Bitcoin Miner. Amazon Is Already a Customer
news.Content:
Cipher Digital's transformation from Bitcoin miner to AI-infrastructure landlord is becoming easier to value because the company now has a real hyperscaler customer. Morgan Stanley raised its price target on September 18 to $54 from $43.50 while keeping an Overweight rating. A major asset supporting Cipher's AI-infrastructure thesis is a 15-year, roughly $5.5 billion lease at Cipher's Black Pearl site with Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ: AMZN ). For Cipher Digital Inc. (NASDAQ: CIFR ), the trade is no longer simply that old mining sites might someday host AI. It is whether long-term cloud contracts can justify the capital required to turn power into data-center capacity.

Amazon gives the pivot a customer, not just a narrative

Cipher Digital Inc. (NASDAQ:CIFR) agreed to provide about 300 megawatts at Black Pearl to Amazon Web Services under a 15-year arrangement. Cipher began delivering capacity in August 2026, two months ahead of schedule, and said rent had commenced. Cipher also has a separate Barber Lake transaction backed by Google, which adds another hyperscaler validation point. The bull case is that powered sites with interconnection rights have become scarce enough that Cipher can monetize land and electricity at infrastructure-like contract values rather than crypto-cycle multiples.

The bear case is financing and execution. A long lease only becomes valuable after the data center is built, commissioned and delivered on schedule. Construction overruns, equipment lead times or a higher cost of capital can eat into returns before rent starts. Cipher's legacy mining exposure also means investors are underwriting a business-model transition while new projects consume cash.

Amazon gets another route to scarce power

Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:AMZN) benefits because AWS can secure capacity without developing every site itself. Its AI demand is already pushing companywide capital spending higher, so long-term leases can trade ownership risk for contractual commitments. The risk is the same one facing every hyperscaler: capacity contracted during a shortage can look expensive if hardware becomes more efficient or AI demand grows more slowly than expected.

Insider Monkey's database counted 72 hedge funds holding Cipher in Q2 2026, up from 49 in Q1. D. E. Shaw's disclosed common-share position was about 14.51 million shares after decreasing 12%, while its call exposure was larger. Amazon's hedge-fund count rose to 369 in Q2 from 353 in Q1, and Arrowstreet Capital increased its position about 24% to 40.35 million shares. The filings predate Morgan Stanley's September target change.

Story Continues

The $54 target will only age well if contracted megawatts translate into rent on time and at attractive project returns. Amazon has already supplied the part of the thesis that used to be missing: a credible end customer. Cipher now has to supply the boring part, which is usually where infrastructure stories are won or lost: financing, construction and delivery.

news.Title: Why Sunrun’s (RUN) Virtual Power Plant Strategy Changes Everything For Its Valuation
news.Content:
Sunrun (NASDAQ: RUN ) anchors the residential solar and distributed energy storage landscape through a vertically integrated asset-ownership and service model. By transforming rooftops into localized generation sites, the company addresses the structural shift toward decentralized power and grid resilience. Its core operational drivers rely on recurring customer contracts, long-term asset monetization, and high-margin hardware attachment rates that insulate its portfolio against volatile utility pricing and provide durable cash compounding over multi-decade residential agreements.

On September 21, Sunrun and Tesla (NASDAQ: TSLA ) announced that their combined fleets of home batteries pushed 580 megawatts onto California's grid during a heat wave on September 9. That is enough power to cover every household in Sacramento County during peak hours, and it came not from a power plant but from more than 140,000 batteries sitting in garages and closets across the state. For a company whose growth numbers have looked shakier lately, the event raises a real question: is Sunrun's fleet now valuable enough to matter to the grid itself?

A Grid Built From Garages

The mechanics behind that dispatch matter as much as the number itself. Sunrun and Tesla coordinated 517 megawatts from Tesla Powerwalls and another 63 megawatts from additional battery brands, activated through two state programs, the California Energy Commission's Demand Side Grid Support program and the California Public Utilities Commission's Emergency Load Reduction Program. The California Independent System Operator triggered the dispatch once day-ahead wholesale prices topped $200 per megawatt-hour. A day later, on September 10, Southern California Edison called its own event, and the two companies delivered more than 140 additional megawatts. Had both nights landed together, the fleet could have pushed more than 720 megawatts onto the grid at once. A Brattle Group analysis commissioned by the two companies estimated these kinds of programs could save Californians up to $206 million by 2028.

That capacity is starting to look like a business line of its own. Sunrun, Tesla, and Renew Home are working to unlock more than 16.8 gigawatts of flexible capacity for hyperscalers and utilities, and a Google-funded distributed power plant with PG&E is set to enroll nearly 21,000 devices as early as this fall. Inside Sunrun's own numbers, the storage attachment rate hit a record 74% in the second quarter, up from 70% a year earlier, and total revenue climbed 53% year over year to $870.0 million, partly on a deal that sells newly originated storage systems to a third party while Sunrun keeps the customer relationship.

Story Continues

The Ledger Gets Tighter

The growth engine behind that fleet is cooling. Subscriber additions fell 31% year over year to 19,793 in the second quarter, and Aggregate Subscriber Value dropped 24% to $1.2 billion. Net Subscriber Value, what is left after accounting for the cost of adding each customer, fell 44% to $9,444. Storage capacity installed slipped 15% and solar capacity installed dropped 23% compared with a year earlier.

Cash is tighter too. Net cash used in operating activities was $186 million in the second quarter, and Cash Generation came in at just $23 million, or $45 million excluding $22 million of equipment safe harbor investments. Sunrun cut its full-year Cash Generation guidance to a range of $200 million to $375 million, down from the $250 million to $450 million it had forecast earlier in the year. The company leaned on debt markets to bridge the gap, raising about $1.5 billion in non-recourse asset-level financing so far in 2026, including a $267 million securitization in August priced at a 6.33% yield. That financing landed at a tighter spread than an earlier deal, a modest positive, but it still shows a company that needs outside capital to keep building while subscriber growth decelerates.

Wall Street Still Not Buying It

Hedge fund ownership of Sunrun fell from 45 funds to 40 in the most recent quarter, a pullback rather than a rush in. Short interest sits at 26.36% of the float, a level that points to heavy organized skepticism among traders betting against the stock. That much shorting also means any run of good news, like the September dispatch event, has the raw material to trigger a sharp squeeze if bears start covering. For now, though, positioning shows more funds walking away than adding in.

The Test Is Just Beginning

Sunrun's batteries just proved they can act like a power plant when California needs one. Whether that translates into steadier profits is a separate question from whether the grid needs the capacity. The bulls have real evidence now: a record attachment rate, a growing hyperscaler pipeline, and a proven dispatch at scale. The bears have their own evidence: slower subscriber growth, thinner cash generation, and a stock market still leaning against the name. Which story wins probably depends on how many more nights like September 9 show up next summer.

While we acknowledge the potential of RUN as an investment, we believe certain AI stocks offer greater upside potential and carry less downside risk. news.Title: Meta Platforms' National TV Ad Shows a Major Shift in the Business Model
news.Content:
Meta Platforms (NASDAQ: META) released the Muse app earlier this month. It's the company's answer to ChatGPT, and it came alongside a nationwide TV ad.

That ad features Muse automatically performing various tasks, such as scheduling events, operating smart home features, and registering a user's child for fall sports. The ad also featured Muse automatically researching and ordering school supplies.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again. In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. Continue »

Not everyone liked the commercial, with some saying it made the product appear too similar to Amazon 's Alexa and didn't fully capture what makes Muse different. However, the success of the Muse app and the rapid shift to national TV ads featuring it indicate a major shift is taking place at Meta Platforms.

The company may finally be diversifying beyond selling ad space

Meta Platforms' biggest strength and weakness is its online advertising business . Revenues from the advertising segment reached $59.3 billion in the second quarter, a 27.5% year-over-year improvement. Online advertising is a high-margin business, so it may be hard to perceive that as a problem.

The issue is that Meta Platforms has absolutely no fallback option if online advertising slows down. Ads provide more than 97% of its total revenue. Meanwhile, rivals like Amazon and Alphabet diversified their revenue streams beyond their core offerings more than a decade ago.

Muse might be the big hit that lets Meta Platforms diversify and accelerate its revenue growth without relying exclusively on ads. Muse got more downloads in its first 12 days than ChatGPT did during the same stretch. Meta Platforms already has 3.6 billion daily active users across its social media platforms , offering a great foundation for Muse to become mainstream.

How Muse will make money

While Muse won't break even right away, its monetization model is already in place. The company makes money when users upgrade their subscriptions for access to expanded token capacity and additional features. However, Meta Platforms CEO Mark Zuckerberg hinted that there were additional ways for Muse to become a moneymaker.

In an interview on Tiff in Tech's YouTube channel, Zuckerberg laid out how Muse could make money as an intermediary for e-commerce transactions. He believes that Muse will help people spend and save money, and Muse will receive a small cut in those cases.

Story Continues

It won't show up meaningfully in financial results for multiple years, but Meta Platforms has a healthy enough balance sheet to wait that long. It's similar to how Amazon and Alphabet waited multiple years for their cloud infrastructure platforms to become profitable. Now, those assets are driving meaningful growth for both companies.

Meta Platforms is trying to achieve the same thing with Muse. Significant app downloads and a quick push toward national TV ads show the level of commitment Meta Platforms is giving Muse.

Meta Platforms is leading the shift from "tell me" to "just do it"

Other AI models can answer questions and provide product recommendations, but Muse is at the forefront of the "just do it" wave. Instead of asking for product recommendations, you can have Muse research products and complete orders for you.

Consumers can provide their email addresses, credit card numbers, and other details that let the AI agent initiate these orders. However, Muse will always ask for a user's permission before finalizing an order. In other words, Muse is set up so you won't end up with a surprise bill.

This shift can turn Muse into a household name despite how crowded the industry has become. ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Grok are some of the many AI models competing for people's attention. If Meta Platforms maintains its technological lead on other AI models and forces its way to the mainstream, it can completely shift Meta Platforms' long-term prospects.

Investors have noticed. The stock has surged by more than 30% over the past month. That rally also came as a major lawsuit against Meta Platforms ended with a judgment far less severe than expected, to the point that it should have no serious impact on the company's revenue.

Meta Platforms' stock has been stuck in the mud for most of the year, but the Muse news sparked a rally that put the stock firmly ahead of the S&P 500 (SNPINDEX: ^GSPC) year to date. That trend is likely to continue in the long run as Muse gains more market share.

news.Title: Old Dogs, New Tech: 3 Legacy Stocks Powering the AI Boom
news.Content:
Key Points

Interested in Corning Incorporated? Here are five stocks we like better.

Legacy technology suppliers like Corning, Cisco, and Texas Instruments provide critical physical infrastructure that AI computing depends on to function.

All three companies show strong earnings growth, solid profit margins, and analyst Moderate Buy ratings with meaningful upside to price targets.

Each firm pairs shareholder-friendly capital policies, including dividends and buybacks, with strategic repositioning toward AI-related infrastructure demand.

Investors seeking steady capital appreciation often overlook older technology sector names, assuming their prime growth years are over. Looking beneath the surface shows how foundational hardware suppliers adapt, and how established balance sheets can capture substantial value during infrastructure transitions. Examining how long-standing industry leaders reposition their core businesses helps investors identify lower-volatility entry points backed by tangible revenue, reliable cash generation, and sustained dividend distributions.

Observing the physical demands of modern computing clarifies why software models eventually collide with real-world infrastructure constraints. Solving operational bottlenecks requires established manufacturing scale, specialized patent libraries, and commercial relationships that newer entrants cannot quickly duplicate.

→ These 3 AI Stocks Sold Off Hard—Even as Their Outlooks Improved

Unplugging the Hype: Hard Truths in Pure Code

Early enthusiasm for AI centered on foundational models and specialized processing units. Training and operating advanced models require moving vast datasets across server clusters, exposing tangible hardware constraints. Data centers face escalating heat dissipation issues, electrical grid limits, and interconnect latency. Software cannot run without reliable physical pipelines, which gives industrial suppliers significant commercial leverage.

Legacy technology leaders supply the physical pathways that keep high-performance computing running. By redirecting manufacturing capacity toward these infrastructure bottlenecks, established suppliers generate steady operating margins. Three industry mainstays show how physical advantages, cyclical turnarounds, and shareholder-friendly capital policies create attractive risk-adjusted opportunities for long-term investors.

→ Insiders Signal Deep Value In DICK's Sporting Goods

Glass Act: Corning Built the Ultimate AI Data Pipeline

Dense computational clusters require specialized glass to transfer data. High-speed optical transceivers and fiber-optic cables link processing clusters together, reducing latency across server racks. Corning Incorporated (NYSE: GLW) has strategically redirected its commercial footprint from consumer display panels toward optical communications for hyperscale data centers.

Story Continues

Corning locked in long-term visibility through an agreement with Verizon to supply over 80 million miles of optical fiber between 2027 and 2032. Teaming up with Qualcomm (NASDAQ: QCOM) and Lumentum (NASDAQ: LITE), Corning is demonstrating high-density 1060-nanometer optical die-to-die connectivity at ECOC 2026 to speed up data movement between parallel processors. Market worries regarding an earlier $2 billion dilution event have also cleared, removing uncertainty around the equity structure.

→ Coach's Momentum Powers Tapestry Despite the Stock's Sharp Pullback

Corning trades near $159 with a market capitalization of around $136.70 billion. Second-quarter earnings came in at 78 cents per share on a 17.1% year-over-year (YOY) rise in revenue. Corning produces an 11.20% net profit margin, an operating return on equity (ROE) of 20.09%, and operating cash flow of about $4.35 per share. While a forward price-to-earnings (P/E) ratio near 48.13 reflects turnaround progress, Wall Street analysts maintain a Moderate Buy consensus with an average price target of $176.50, implying around 11% potential appreciation.

Guarding the Gateway: Cisco Plugs Enterprise AI Leaks

Bringing machine learning tools into corporate environments creates notable data protection challenges and complex traffic flows. Cisco Systems, Inc. (NASDAQ: CSCO) has shifted from traditional network switching to an integrated software and cybersecurity provider, supported by its acquisition of Splunk.

By uniting network telemetry with specialized security architectures alongside NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA), Cisco provides the visibility organizations need to protect proprietary data across distributed networks. Financial performance highlights this progression toward recurring subscription revenue. Cisco posted quarterly earnings per share (EPS) of $1.22, beating consensus expectations by 5 cents, while revenue rose 17.6% YoY, pushing annual sales toward $63.33 billion.

Cisco supports a market capitalization of around $433.51 billion, with a 20.95% net profit margin and a 30.16% ROE. Operating cash flow is about $4.34 per share. Following an 8% pullback over three months, Cisco stock trades near $111, which equates to a reasonable forward P/E of about 25.16. Capital allocation provides downside protection, highlighted by an active $15 billion share repurchase plan and a dependable 1.51% dividend yield. Analyst consensus is a Moderate Buy, with an average price target of $129.68, representing about 16% upside potential.

Steady Current: Texas Instruments Powers the Physical AI Edge

Digital microchips cannot function without analog semiconductors to convert real-world signals, manage electrical currents, and regulate system power. Texas Instruments Incorporated (NASDAQ: TXN) designs the essential components that interface digital brains with physical machinery, positioning the supplier at the heart of automotive electrification and smart factory automation.

The broader analog semiconductor industry endured an extended inventory correction over the past two years. Operating metrics now signal a clear inflection point. Texas Instruments announced quarterly EPS of $2.14, outpacing consensus projections of $1.91 by 23 cents as revenue expanded 22.8% YOY. This cyclical rebound supports the decision to construct low-cost, domestic 300-millimeter wafer manufacturing plants.

Texas Instruments generates exceptional financial returns, producing $5 billion in net income on annual revenue of approximately $17.68 billion. This output translates to a 31.11% net profit margin, a 35.77% ROE, and cash flow of about $7.72 per share, backed by a current ratio of 4.86. On Sept. 18, 2026, leadership increased the quarterly payout by 7% to $1.52 per share, marking 23 consecutive years of dividend increases. Trading near $269.27 with a forward P/E around 31.60 and a 2.11% dividend yield, Texas Instruments' stock carries an average analyst target of $312.12, pointing to roughly 16.9% upside.

Building Long-Term Exposure to AI Infrastructure

Assessing turnaround opportunities requires looking past speculative market trends to evaluate structural profitability and competitive advantages. High-performance computing relies heavily on physical manufacturing. Organizations that provide optical data lines, enterprise network protection, and analog power regulation hold durable operational leverage.

Corning, Cisco Systems, and Texas Instruments illustrate how mature corporate structures, disciplined shareholder return programs, and critical product lines weather broader economic cycles. Multiples across the technology sector warrant attentive risk management, yet these three established leaders combine fundamental stability with direct participation in long-term infrastructure expansion.

Investors seeking exposure to physical computing architecture can consider accumulating shares during market pullbacks or scaling in through dollar-cost averaging as quarterly filings confirm margin durability. Reviewing balance sheet health and tracking institutional positioning can help identify appropriate entry points for a diversified portfolio.

news.Title: 休市錯過全球AI大漲？日股周四開盤拚補漲
news.Content:
日本股市結束「白銀周」連假，周四(24日)恢復交易。全球人工智慧(AI)概念股本周重拾漲勢，日股有望補漲；但日元持續走貶，也讓市場緊盯日本當局是否干預匯市。大阪交易的日經225指數12月期貨，已較上周五現貨收盤水準高出約2.5%。日本公債則受油價下跌與日銀(日本央行/BOJ)升息前景牽動，走勢較難判斷。

AI熱潮再起 半導體股可望領漲

Meta Platforms(META-US)新推出的AI代理初步展現成效，阿里巴巴(BABA-US)也發表號稱中國性能最強的AI晶片，帶動全球AI交易回溫。此前美國主要AI業者呼籲放慢開發速度，一度令市場擔憂產業成長；如今美股那斯達克100指數周二在晶片股帶動下，創下6月以來首個新高。

Vantage Global Prime分析師Hebe Chen指出，AI股反彈、風險情緒改善與油價回落，為日股提供補漲空間，也暫緩通膨與利率壓力。iFast Financial分析師Hu You預期，東京威力科創(8035-JP)、愛德萬測試(6857-JP)等晶片設備商可望受惠，揖斐電(IBIDEN)(4062-JP)與鎧俠(285A-JP)也可能走高。日經225指數截至9月18日的五個交易日上漲1.6%，為約一個月來最佳單周表現。

日元連貶添干預變數 債市觀望日銀

日銀上周五升息，並表明仍可能進一步緊縮，但欠缺明確指引，令日元交易員失望。日元當天一度貶1.3%至1美元兌158.05日元，隨後因《日本經濟新聞》報導日銀向市場詢問匯價而收斂跌幅。詢價常被視為可能干預的前兆，但賣壓其後再起。日元周三東京時間傍晚報157.88，朝連跌第四天邁進，若成真將是8月下旬以來最長連跌；選擇權市場也顯示，投資人加強防範干預後日元反彈。

布蘭特原油跌破每桶100美元、美國公債殖利率本周走低，原可支撐日債，日銀政策的不確定性卻可能抵銷利多。Hu You認為，升息墊高短期利率底部，短天期日債價格將承壓。《彭博》經濟學家木村太郎指出，日銀總裁植田和男態度比預期更鷹派，強調基礎通膨正接近2%目標，卻鮮少談及疲弱日元。

本周川普與中國國家主席習近平的會晤，也是市場焦點。Chen提醒，日元貶值起初有利出口股，若持續推升通膨與升息預期，日債恐再度承壓。

news.Title: AI代理時代CPU翻身　黃世聰：創意、聯發科、欣興最值得關注
news.Content:
台股本週一、週二持續走高，創下48601點的歷史新高。財經專家 黃世聰 在節目《聰明理財大小世》表示，美伊戰爭、川習會與美國升息等市場疑慮似乎逐步獲得解答，AI泡沫的擔憂也出現轉變。他認為長假前雖可能震盪，但長假後台股仍有機會挑戰5萬點、甚至更高。

黃世聰分析，美國聯邦基準利率目前在3.75%至4%，30年期公債殖利率則在5%以上，對股市形成壓力，因為台灣50過去一、二十年的平均殖利率約4%至5%。在這種情況下，資金會看重經濟成長率。他指出，美國今年成長約2%，歐元區約1%，南韓約2%至3%，日本約0.8%至1%，台灣則高達11%，市場因此預期明年股息將大增，外資近期動輒以數百億元買超台股，同時賣超南韓與印度股市。

針對23日至25日登場的川習會，黃世聰認為雙方氣氛不會太差，可能達成中國大量採購美國商品等協議。他指出，這次由川普親自到機場接機，規格相當高，顯示雙方應已有偏正面的初步共識。他也整理2017年以來的歷次川習會，指出會後股市短線或有波動，但長線多半上漲。

在AI方面，黃世聰說，Meta推出的AI代理「Muse」可以連結臉書、IG與Threads，替使用者比價下單、處理客服等事務，並以獨立雲端虛擬機器保護帳密，金額超過5000元時會請使用者確認。Muse上線後下載量衝高，帶動Meta股價在週一美股早盤大漲約11%。他指出，AI代理時代的決策運算更依賴CPU，AMD、英特爾、Arm、高通等股價全面走強，費城半導體指數也已突破下降壓力線。

黃世聰點名台灣CPU供應鏈，範圍涵蓋設計與IP、晶圓代工、封測、IC載板及零組件等族群。他特別看好三檔：一是創意，已有法人預估將成為下一檔萬元股，但短線漲多，建議等拉回再觀察；二是聯發科，明年獲利成長可望達一倍以上，高於台積電的三至四成，他認為是大型股中最值得關注的一檔；三是載板指標欣興，他指出一座台積電晶圓廠需要多座ABF廠配合，股價已領先反應。

黃世聰表示，AI代理讓AI敘事重新復活，CPU供應鏈將是台股另一波機會的開始。至於有業界大老看好台股上看10萬點，他則說是樂觀數字，「我們就邊走邊看」。

想了解更多精彩內容，歡迎持續收看《品觀點》網路節目《聰明理財大小世》！

*投資警語：投資一定有風險，投資有賺有賠，投資前應檢視自身能力。

news.Title: 台股總市值5.3兆美元超車印度躍全球第4 神山單日貢獻逾1兆元
news.Content:
台股今(23)日開高，雖呈高檔震盪，但在權值股領軍走揚下，終場仍上漲 357.12 點，以 48,157.29 點作收，再度改寫歷史新高紀錄，台灣資本市場的世界排名也出現歷史性突破，最新總市值衝上 5.3 兆美元，首度超越印度，躋身全球第 4 大股票市場。而最大的功臣莫過於護國神山台積電，單日就貢獻了超過新台幣 1 兆元的市值增幅。

根據國際財經數據網站《MarketCapWatch》截至今日下午 5 時的最新統計，台灣股市總市值達到約 5.3 兆美元，正式超越印度的 4.94 兆美元，榮登全球第 4 大股票市場。目前全球前三大股市分別為美國 82.7 兆美元、中國 21.22 兆美元及日本 8.59 兆美元。

全球第 6 至 10 名的資本市場，依序為英國 4.86 兆美元、韓國 4.5 兆美元、加拿大 4.45 兆美元、法國 3.08 兆美元以及德國 3 兆美元。台股不僅展現強勁的本土資金動能，在全球資本市場的戰略地位亦大幅提升。

台股這波市值暴衝的核心引擎即為權王台積電(2330-TW)，今日股價收在 2,500 元、大漲 40 元，市值衝高至 64.83 兆元，單日狂增約 1 兆元，不但為台股創高奠定基石，台積美元計算的市值2.05兆美元，也在《MarketCapWatch》全球個股市值中排名第7名。與排名第6的SpaceX(SPCX-US)市值2.08兆美元相去不遠。

在半導體與 AI 供應鏈族群拉抬下，上市前二十大個股排名也出現顯著變化，ABF 載板廠欣興(3037-TW)上漲 40 元收在 1,160 元，市值激增 655 億元，站上 1.9 兆元，並成功攀升至第 9 名，將南亞(1303-TW)擠至第 10 名。

散熱龍頭奇鋐(3017-TW)市值上揚314億元、來到 1.36 兆元，名次超越中信金(2891-TW)前進至第 15 名；被動元件大廠國巨*(2327-TW)市值小幅回升，超越緯穎(6669-TW)名列第 18 名。

傳產、金融族群今天普遍面臨回檔，南亞(1303-TW)市值縮水 317 億元；高價股川湖(2059-TW)大跌 280 元收在 12,390 元，市值下修至 1.18 兆元，為上市前二十大中跌幅最深個股。

news.Title: 台股4萬8157點創收盤新高 群益投顧：年底指數上看5萬3千點
news.Content:
不畏中秋節連假後變盤，台股指數持續上攻，23日以4萬8157點創收盤新高；群益金融集團今舉辦「2026年第4季投資展望說明會」， 群益投顧董事長蔡明彥表示，台股指數創新高，但台積電今收在2500元、尚未突破2535元前高，雖然要留意三星、英特爾搶單，但仍看好AI需求帶動高階製程，預計 EPS 持續攀升、2028年將朝160 元以上邁進；蔡明彥表示，第4季旺季可期、機會與風險並存，台股指數年底前有機會挑戰5萬3千點大關。

蔡明彥表示，當前金融投資最大風險包括美伊衝突、俄烏戰事延宕，地緣政治風險帶來能源、糧食價格高漲，將衍伸通膨上揚；另外，美國期中選舉變數多，若依照美國總統川普當前的民調低迷，共和黨很可能大敗，而民主黨傾向反對AI高速成長，但蔡明彥認為，即使民主黨不全力支持，對股價衝擊可能如先前「AI末日論」般，僅影響幾天效益就沒了。

群益投顧總經理范振鴻表示，回顧過去美股100年的經驗來看，第4季上漲機率77.5％，下跌為22.5％，遇到期中選舉上漲機率為80％，平均漲幅6.4％至66％，通常選前震盪、選後上漲；美股經濟成長與獲利能力強勁，加上聯準會日前升息、利空出盡，預料是美股後續上漲主要關鍵。

范振鴻表示，台股今年獲利成長76.5％，預估明年仍有18.69％成長，股市將持續走強，預估台股第4季指數區間將介於4萬3千點至5萬3千點間，中東局勢持續緊張、原油價格波動下，近期仍將維持高檔震盪偏多格局。

news.Title: Oklo vs. NuScale vs. BWX Technologies: Ranking the 3 Popular Nuclear Stocks From Worst to First
news.Content:
Nuclear power is making a comeback, with Oklo (NYSE: OKLO), NuScale Power (NYSE: SMR), and BWX Technologies (NYSE: BWXT) each offering distinct nuclear stories. But which one stands out? Here's a look at these popular nuclear stocks, ranked from worst to first.

NuScale has great technology, but is still waiting for the story to become real

NuScale Power has one of the easiest stories for investors to understand. The company has developed a small modular reactor, and its design has already received certification from the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC). NuScale is also building out its supply chain and announced progress on securing components for its reactor.

Missed AI's "Act 1"? Act 2 Could Be 15x Bigger. Most investors think they missed the AI boat because they didn't buy Nvidia in 2005. But according to our analysts, we're only at the end of "Act 1"—the R&D phase. "Act 2" is the global rollout. Continue »

The problem is that having an approved reactor design isn't the same thing as having a commercial nuclear fleet that's already operational. That remains the biggest issue for the stock.

NuScale's most important potential project is tied to its partnership with ENTRA1 and discussions with the Tennessee Valley Authority. The opportunity is potentially enormous, but the power purchase agreement investors want to see hasn't been signed yet. Also, its Romania project is yet another potential path to deployment, but it's also still in the development phase rather than in commercial operations.

The upside could be huge, but for now, investors are still waiting to see the company turn its plans into reality. So, while NuScale is still working on its tech, another company is already taking the next step.

Oklo's commercial story is becoming more substantial

Instead of competing with the traditional large-reactor model, Oklo focuses on compact fast reactors to provide power directly to customers. That makes the company more interesting in a world where data centers are trying to secure reliable energy as quickly as possible.

The company has already made meaningful progress. For example, it received approval from the Department of Energy for the preliminary safety analysis for its Aurora powerhouse at Idaho National Laboratory, an important milestone that moves the project further into the actual safety and construction process.

Oklo is also progressing on its fuel strategy, including its Aurora Fuel Fabrication Facility, while continuing regulatory work with the NRC. The NRC's records show ongoing pre-application work around Aurora, including reviews of key design and licensing materials.

Story Continues

But Oklo has yet to deploy a commercially operating reactor, and its timeline still depends on construction, regulatory, and operational matters.

Oklo offers plenty of upside if Aurora takes off, but another company has a nuclear business that's already up and running.

BWX Technologies has a nuclear business that already works

BWX Technologies sets itself apart by being embedded in the nuclear industry. The company has exposure to naval nuclear propulsion, government nuclear programs, and nuclear manufacturing. These days, it's also expanding into advanced reactors and next-generation nuclear technologies.

Recent developments have only strengthened that position. The U.S. Army selected BWX's Advanced Nuclear Reactor for its Janus power program for military bases, with the first planned deployment at Fort Campbell on the Kentucky-Tennessee border. The project gives BWX another potential path into the fast-growing market for distributed nuclear power.

At the same time, BWX is expanding its manufacturing footprint. For example, the company acquired Precision Components Group, strengthening its nuclear manufacturing, while its TRISO fuel helped a reactor achieve first criticality under a Department of Energy program.

BWX also continues to win work tied to U.S. national security and government infrastructure, having been selected to develop the conceptual design for a new lithium processing facility at the Y-12 National Security Complex.

Ultimately, the biggest difference between these three stocks comes down to how much of their story has already been proven.

Ranking the three nuclear stocks from worst to first

NuScale, Oklo, and BWX offer three different ways to play the nuclear revival, but they're not created equal.

BWX Technologies is the safest and clear winner of the three, with a real nuclear business already generating revenue on top of growing exposure to advanced reactors. If the nuclear build-out continues, BWX is arguably the best positioned of the group to benefit.

For investors who prefer to wait on the sidelines until a technology proves itself, NuScale is still working to bring its reactor design to commercial projects. And that makes Oklo the higher-risk, higher-reward pick, focused on next-generation reactors that still need to be built and scaled.

Missed Nvidia in 2009? This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again

In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. If you'd invested $5,000 then, you'd be sitting on $2,955,706 today.*

Now, for the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. It's a key player in the $1.8 trillion space race, and with the stock recently sitting 20% off its highs, the window to get in early is closing fast.

news.Title: This AI Memory Stock Is Up More Than 650% in 2026. Micron Investors Should Pay Attention
news.Content:
One of 2026's wildest AI trades is not Nvidia. It is SanDisk.

SanDisk Corporation (NASDAQ: SNDK ) was up more than 650% for the year after an 11% surge on September 18. The rally has turned a familiar memory manufacturer into one of the S&P 500's best-performing stocks. Micron Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ: MU ) has enjoyed the same AI-memory shortage, but SanDisk's move has been in another universe.

There was no single Friday announcement big enough to explain the latest jump. That makes the investor question more interesting: is SanDisk still repricing around structurally tighter storage demand, or has momentum outrun the underlying improvement?

AI is creating more than an HBM shortage

Training and inference get most of the attention because they consume GPUs and high-bandwidth memory. The output has to live somewhere. AI systems generate enormous quantities of data, model checkpoints and inference content, supporting demand for NAND flash and enterprise storage.

That is the direct channel for SanDisk Corporation (NASDAQ:SNDK). That leverage is already showing up in the numbers, with fiscal fourth-quarter revenue rising 51% sequentially to $8.97 billion, while datacenter revenue more than doubled sequentially. SanDisk also joined the S&P 100 on September 21, creating additional index-related demand.

The valuation risk is visible in the stock chart. A 655% year-to-date gain means investors are no longer paying for mere recovery. SanDisk now has to deliver sustained pricing, volume and margins into expectations that have changed radically.

Micron Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ:MU) has a broader AI-memory position. It sells DRAM, HBM and NAND, so it can participate in both accelerator memory and storage demand. That diversification is attractive while memory remains tight, although it also exposes Micron to the same cyclical danger if new capacity eventually catches up.

Hedge funds were already moving before the latest surge

Insider Monkey's database showed 128 hedge funds holding SanDisk in Q2, up from 114 in Q1. Arrowstreet Capital held roughly 2.17 million shares after trimming its position 24%. Micron's holder count jumped much more sharply, to 184 funds from 154. Coatue Management increased its MU position by roughly 1,794% during the quarter.

SanDisk's August 31 short interest stood near six million shares, approximately 4.1% of float, with about half a day to cover.

The AI-memory trade still has fundamental support. The harder question after a 655% gain is how much support the price already assumes. SanDisk now needs results worthy of one of the market's most extraordinary rerating's, while Micron offers a less explosive but broader way to own the same scarcity cycle.

Story Continues

While we acknowledge the potential of SNDK and MU as investments, we believe certain other AI stocks offer greater upside potential and carry less downside risk. Amazon.com (AMZN), for instance, blocked Muse from accessing its shopping platform, citing privacy and security concerns. According to the company, the agent bypasses personalization features and might capture customer credentials and scrape account data.

Still, Amazon access is hardly the only factor shaping Meta's AI strategy. Muse has led app store charts for nearly two weeks, surpassing Claude and Grok. Additionally, Shopify (SHOP) partnered with Meta to enable agentic checkout across its merchant network, giving Muse an alternative e-commerce route.

Moreover, expectations around Meta's upcoming Connect event on Wednesday, Sept. 23, and continued AI infrastructure investments have boosted positive sentiment, driving the share price up 11.3% on Monday, Sept. 21, amid strong analyst optimism about Muse and the company's broader AI strategy.

About Meta Stock

Headquartered in Menlo Park, California, Meta Platforms operates across social media, messaging, AI, virtual and augmented reality, and smart glasses. Its Family of Apps comprises Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp, Threads, and Meta AI. Through Reality Labs, the company is also expanding its footprint in Meta Quest devices, AI-powered glasses, wearables, and immersive digital experiences.

With a market cap of about $1.7 trillion, Meta is one of the largest companies in the technology sector. Yet its size has not insulated the stock from investor concerns. Over the past year, Wall Street has grown more cautious about the scale of Meta's AI spending and how much those investments can ultimately translate into stronger financial returns.

Story Continues

Against that backdrop, META stock fell 4.8% over the past 52 weeks. The recent trend, however, has been considerably stronger. Meta's shares are up 24.9% in the past six months and have advanced 34.8% in the last month.

Meta's stronger share performance has also come with a valuation that commands a premium relative to the industry. The stock currently trades at 21.34 times forward adjusted earnings and 6.67 times sales, with both multiples above their respective industry averages.

Shareholders also receive a dividend. Meta distributes $2.10 per share annually, resulting in a yield of 0.32%. The company's next payment of $0.53 per share is scheduled for Monday, Sept. 28 for shareholders of record on Sept. 21.

A Closer Look at Meta's Q2 Earnings

Meta disclosed its Q2 FY2026 results on July 29, which highlighted the growing tension between strong top-line growth and the rising cost of building out its AI ambitions. Revenue reached $60.8 billion, up 28% year over year (YOY) and ahead of the $60.2 billion analysts expected.

Advertising remained the primary growth engine, with Family of Apps advertising revenue rising 27% YOY to $59.4 billion. That increase was driven by a 14% rise in ad impressions and a 12% increase in the average price per ad, pointing to continued strength across both advertising volume and pricing.

However, the revenue growth did not flow through to earnings. EPS fell 13.4% to $6.18, missing the roughly $7.22 analysts had projected. Meta recorded $2.40 billion in charges related to legal proceedings and $1.18 billion in severance expenses tied to the May headcount reduction, both of which weighed on the quarter's profitability.

Moreover, total costs and expenses surged 55.2% YOY to $42 billion. The strain also showed up in cash generation. Cash flow from operating activities totaled $31.9 billion, but free cash flow fell sharply to $784 million from $8.5 billion a year earlier. CapEx reached $31.1 billion for the quarter as Meta ramped up spending on AI infrastructure.

Against this backdrop, Meta's near-term outlook remains closely tied to both revenue growth and investment levels. For Q3 FY2026, the company expects revenue of $61 billion to $64 billion.

Meta has also raised its 2026 capital-spending outlook to $130 billion to $145 billion from the previous $125 billion to $145 billion range. The company also raised the lower end of its full-year expense outlook to $165 billion to $169 billion to reflect the legal charge, while maintaining that 2026 operating income will exceed the previous year.

In this context, analysts forecast Q3 FY2026 EPS to decrease 11.9% YOY to $6.39, with full-year FY2026 EPS expected to drop 5.9% from a year ago to $27.93. Nonetheless, FY2027 is expected to recover, with EPS rising 23% YOY to $34.36.

What Do Analysts Expect for Meta Stock?

Analyst sentiment toward Meta remains notably positive, particularly around the company's ability to translate its AI investments into stronger advertising growth and new monetization opportunities.

On that note, Ken Gawrelski of Wells Fargo maintains a "Buy" rating on META stock while raising his price target from $640 to $796. Mark Mahaney of Evercore ISI also reiterated a "Buy" rating, with an $860 target, citing confidence in Meta's AI-driven advertising growth and monetization potential.

That constructive view is reflected in Wall Street's overall rating of "Strong Buy." Among 54 analysts covering Meta, 45 rate the stock a "Strong Buy," two assign a "Moderate Buy," and seven recommend "Hold."

The price targets reinforce the market's expectations for further appreciation. The average price target stands at $758.26, representing potential upside of 2.3%, while the Street-high target of $1,000 implies a 34.9% gain from current levels.

news.Title: 台股散戶信心回流　8月證券劃撥存款餘額衝4.57兆創高
news.Content:
（中央社記者潘姿羽台北23日電）7月亞股浮現去槓桿風暴，台股一度盤中重挫逾2000點，重創散戶信心，不過央行今天公布有「散戶信心風向球」之稱的8月證券劃撥存款餘額升至新台幣4兆5712億元，創歷史新高，單月暴增3889億元，也創下史上最大增量，透露散戶信心回穩的跡象。

央行今天公布8月金融情況，M1B及M2年增率分別下降為6.65%及6.79%，M2年增率下降主要是外匯存款及活期儲蓄存款成長減緩所致。

觀察與股市相關指標，7月證券劃撥存款餘額受到亞股去槓桿風暴影響，證券劃撥存款餘額單月暴跌2413億元，不過8月又大增3889億元，終止連2月下跌，整體規模也衝上4.57兆元，再創歷史新高；此外，8月股市融資餘額同步走揚，升至7589億元。

央行經研處行務委員劉淑敏表示，證券劃撥存款餘額處於蠻高水準，相關數值也都算不錯；至於8月外匯存款期底餘額升至9兆6488億元，續創歷史新高，劉淑敏說，除了出口暢旺，帶動廠商貨款收入增加，新台幣升值也連帶推升其規模。

值得注意的是，今年以來市場資金需求升溫，連帶推高相關指標。8月全體貨幣機構放款與投資期底餘額合計為57.4兆元，年增9.43%，創逾27年半最大增幅，主因是其中的放款成長顯著，8月期底餘額為47.7兆元，年增10.49%，則是逾21年半最大增幅。

劉淑敏說明，製造業資金需求增加是放款成長的主要動能，隨著AI熱潮延續、出口暢旺，電子零組件製造業等相關供應鏈積極擴增資本支出，購地、購料、興建廠房等資金需求升溫，帶動銀行放款顯著成長。（編輯：林淑媛）1150923

news.Title: 10月還要升息？Fed重演暴力升息？李其展分析美股台股撐得住嗎
news.Content:
聯準會睽違三年再度升息一碼，市場最擔心的不是「升一次」，而是會不會重演2022至2023年的連續升息循環。《財經風向球》主持人小畢專訪財經專家 李其展 ，解析 10月 、12月是否可能接力升息，以及美股、台股哪些族群最先感受到資金退潮壓力。李其展指出，目前市場主要共識仍是第四季再升一碼，但最新預期已出現變化，10月提前升息並非不可能。

10月若再升息 哪些股票先撐不住？

判斷Fed下一步，可留意10月初公布的就業數據及10月中公布的通膨數據。若勞動市場持續強勁、通膨再度升溫，聯準會就有更充分的理由再次升息；若 10月、12月 連續升息，市場承受的壓力也會明顯放大。李其展分析，若升息能壓低通膨、經濟又沒有轉壞，股市未必立刻崩跌；最危險的情況，是通膨尚未降溫、經濟卻已走弱。

升息衝擊並非所有產業一致，其中高估值、高資本支出公司風險最高。部分AI、資料中心業者需要大量舉債籌資，利率升高將推升融資成本；當獲利成長無法支撐高估值，股價便可能快速修正。李其展提醒，股市通常不會等到升息確定才下跌，費半、那斯達克等科技指數，往往會提前反映資金縮水與政策轉向。

AI股要全賣還是續抱？

面對升息與AI行情同時存在，李其展認為，投資人不必把科技股全部賣掉，但也不宜集中全押。AI仍可能是科技股長線上漲的重要動力，現階段可優先保留具獲利能力、長期發展性較明確的公司，並透過市值型ETF、科技型ETF與現金部位分散風險，避免因害怕升息太早清空，反而錯過後續行情。若希望降低波動，可將部分資金停泊在短債。李其展表示，短債雖可能受到升息影響，但存續期間較短、價格波動通常較小，適合作為等待股市修正時的資金停泊處；長債殖利率雖較高，價格波動也更大，若投資目的在求穩，配置比例不宜過高。

日圓不升反貶 恐再挑戰160？

日本升息後日圓反而走貶，關鍵在於日本央行態度不如Fed強硬，市場對後續

news.Title: Is Marvell Stock Outperforming the S&P 500?
news.Content:
Headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware, Marvell Technology Inc. (MRVL) is a leading semiconductor company that develops data infrastructure solutions for cloud, AI, networking, and enterprise markets. Its portfolio includes custom ASICs, networking chips, optical and electrical connectivity solutions, and storage technologies that enable high-speed data movement and processing.

Companies with a market cap over $200 billion are typically referred to as "mega-cap stocks, and MRVL, with a market cap of $225.7 billion, fits the label. With growing exposure to AI-driven data center demand and custom silicon, Marvell is positioned to benefit from continued investment in next-generation computing infrastructure.
